verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt call them to mind among all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath driven thee,
verses.pt: E será que, quando te sobrevierem todas estas coisas, a bênção e a maldição que pus diante de ti, e te conscientizares em teu coração em meio de todas as nações às quais o SENHOR teu Deus te houver expulsado,
verses.en_web: It shall happen, when all these things have come on you, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before you, and you shall call them to mind among all the nations, where Yahweh your God has driven you,
verses.en_bbe: Now when all these things have come on you, the blessing and the curse which I have put before you, if the thought of them comes back to your minds, when you are living among the nations where the Lord your God has sent you,

verses.en: And shalt return unto the LORD thy God, and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy children, with all thine heart, and with all thy soul;
verses.pt: E te converteres ao SENHOR teu Deus, e obedeceres à sua voz conforme tudo o que eu te mando hoje, tu e teus filhos, com todo teu coração e com toda tua alma,
verses.en_web: and return to Yahweh your God, and obey his voice according to all that I command you today, you and your children, with all your heart, and with all your soul;
verses.en_bbe: And your hearts are turned again to the Lord your God, and you give ear to his word which I give you today, you and your children, with all your heart and with all your soul:

verses.en: That then the LORD thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath scattered thee.
verses.pt: O SENHOR te restaurará de teu infortúnio, terá misericórdia de ti, e voltará a recolher-te de todos os povos aos quais o SENHOR, teu Deus, te houver disperso.
verses.en_web: that then Yahweh your God will release you from captivity, have compassion on you, and will return and gather you from all the peoples where Yahweh your God has scattered you.
verses.en_bbe: Then the Lord will have pity on you, changing your fate, and taking you back again from among all the nations where you have been forced to go.

verses.en: If any of thine be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will the LORD thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee:
verses.pt: Se houveres sido lançado até a extremidade dos céus, dali te recolherá o SENHOR teu Deus, e dali te tomará:
verses.en_web: If your outcasts are in the uttermost parts of the heavens, from there Yahweh your God will gather you, and from there he will bring you back.
verses.en_bbe: Even if those who have been forced out are living in the farthest part of heaven, the Lord your God will go in search of you, and take you back;

verses.en: And the LORD thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it; and he will do thee good, and multiply thee above thy fathers.
verses.pt: E te fará voltar o SENHOR teu Deus à terra que herdaram teus pais, e a possuirás; e te fará bem, e te multiplicará mais que a teus pais.
verses.en_web: Yahweh your God will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you will possess it. He will do you good, and increase your numbers more than your fathers.
verses.en_bbe: Placing you again in the land of your fathers as your heritage; and he will do you good, increasing you till you are more in number than your fathers were.

verses.en: And the LORD thy God will circumcise thine heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.
verses.pt: E circuncidará o SENHOR teu Deus teu coração, e o coração de tua descendência, para que ames ao SENHOR teu Deus com todo teu coração e com toda tua alma, a fim de que tu vivas.
verses.en_web: Yahweh your God will circumcise your heart, and the heart of your offspring, to love Yahweh your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, that you may live.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord your God will give to you and to your seed a circumcision of the heart, so that, loving him with all your heart and all your soul, you may have life.

verses.en: And the LORD thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, which persecuted thee.
verses.pt: E porá o SENHOR teu Deus todas estas maldições sobre teus inimigos, e sobre teus aborrecedores que te perseguiram.
verses.en_web: Yahweh your God will put all these curses on your enemies, and on those who hate you, who persecuted you.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord your God will put all these curses on those who are against you, and on your haters who put a cruel yoke on you.

verses.en: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of the LORD, and do all his commandments which I command thee this day.
verses.pt: E tu voltarás, e ouvirás a voz do SENHOR, e porás por obra todos os seus mandamentos, que eu te intimo hoje.
verses.en_web: You shall return and obey Yahweh’s voice, and do all his commandments which I command you today.
verses.en_bbe: And you will again give ear to the voice of the Lord, and do all his orders which I have given you today.

verses.en: And the LORD thy God will make thee plenteous in every work of thine hand, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy land, for good: for the LORD will again rejoice over thee for good, as he rejoiced over thy fathers:
verses.pt: E te fará o SENHOR teu Deus abundar em toda obra de tuas mãos, no fruto de teu ventre, no fruto de teu animal, e no fruto de tua terra, para o bem: porque o SENHOR voltará a se alegrar sobre ti para o bem, da maneira que se alegrou sobre teus pais;
verses.en_web: Yahweh your God will make you plenteous in all the work of your hand, in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, for good; for Yahweh will again rejoice over you for good, as he rejoiced over your fathers;
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord your God will make you fertile in all good things, blessing the work of your hands, and the fruit of your body, and the fruit of your cattle, and the fruit of your land: for the Lord will have joy in you, as he had in your fathers:

verses.en: If thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, and if thou turn unto the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.
verses.pt: Quando ouvires a voz do SENHOR teu Deus, para guardar seus mandamentos e seus estatutos escritos neste livro da lei; quando te converteres ao SENHOR teu Deus com todo teu coração e com toda tua alma.
verses.en_web: if you will obey Yahweh your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law; if you turn to Yahweh your God with all your heart, and with all your soul.
verses.en_bbe: If you give ear to the voice of the Lord your God, keeping his orders and his laws which are recorded in this book of the law, and turning to the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

verses.en: For this commandment which I command thee this day, it is not hidden from thee, neither is it far off.
verses.pt: Porque este mandamento que eu te intimo hoje, não te é encoberto, nem está longe:
verses.en_web: For this commandment which I command you today is not too hard for you or too distant.
verses.en_bbe: For these orders which I have given you today are not strange and secret, and are not far away.

verses.en: It is not in heaven, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
verses.pt: Não está no céu, para que digas: Quem subirá por nós ao céu, e nos o trará e o apresentará para nós, para que o cumpramos?
verses.en_web: It is not in heaven, that you should say, “Who will go up for us to heaven, and bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”
verses.en_bbe: They are not in heaven, for you to say, Who will go up to heaven for us and give us knowledge of them so that we may do them?

verses.en: Neither is it beyond the sea, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
verses.pt: Nem está da outra parte do mar, para que digas: Quem passará por nós o mar, para que o traga até nós e a nós o apresente, a fim de que o cumpramos?
verses.en_web: Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, “Who will go over the sea for us, and bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”
verses.en_bbe: And they are not across the sea, for you to say, Who will go over the sea for us and give us news of them so that we may do them?

verses.en: But the word is very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.
verses.pt: Porque muito próxima de ti está a palavra, em tua boca e em teu coração, para que a cumpras.
verses.en_web: But the word is very near to you, in your mouth and in your heart, that you may do it.
verses.en_bbe: But the word is very near you, in your mouth and in your heart, so that you may do it.

verses.en: See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil;
verses.pt: Olha, eu pus diante de ti hoje a vida e o bem, a morte e o mal:
verses.en_web: Behold, I have set before you today life and prosperity, and death and evil.
verses.en_bbe: See, I have put before you today, life and good, and death and evil;

verses.en: In that I command thee this day to love the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that thou mayest live and multiply: and the LORD thy God shall bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it.
verses.pt: Porque eu te mando hoje que ames ao SENHOR teu Deus, que andes em seus caminhos, e guardes seus mandamentos e seus estatutos e seus regulamentos, para que vivas e sejas multiplicado, e o SENHOR teu Deus te abençoe na terra à qual entras para possuí-la.
verses.en_web: For I command you today to love Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, that you may live and multiply, and that Yahweh your God may bless you in the land where you go in to possess it.
verses.en_bbe: In giving you orders today to have love for the Lord your God, to go in his ways and keep his laws and his orders and his decisions, so that you may have life and be increased, and that the blessing of the Lord your God may be with you in the land where you are going, the land of your heritage.

verses.en: But if thine heart turn away, so that thou wilt not hear, but shalt be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them;
verses.pt: Mas se teu coração se desviar, e não ouvires, e fores incitado, e te inclinares a deuses alheios, e os servires;
verses.en_web: But if your heart turns away, and you will not hear, but are drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them;
verses.en_bbe: But if your heart is turned away and your ear is shut, and you go after those who would make you servants and worshippers of other gods:

verses.en: I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish, and that ye shall not prolong your days upon the land, whither thou passest over Jordan to go to possess it.
verses.pt: Declaro-vos hoje que certamente perecereis: não tereis longos dias sobre a terra, para ir à qual passas o Jordão para possuí-la.
verses.en_web: I denounce to you today, that you will surely perish. You will not prolong your days in the land where you pass over the Jordan to go in to possess it.
verses.en_bbe: I give witness against you this day that destruction will certainly be your fate, and your days will be cut short in the land where you are going, the land of your heritage on the other side of Jordan.

verses.en: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live:
verses.pt: Aos céus e a terra chamo por testemunhas hoje contra vós, que pus diante de vós a vida e a morte, a bênção e a maldição: escolhe, pois, a vida, para que vivas tu e tua descendência:
verses.en_web: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that I have set before you life and death, the blessing and the curse. Therefore choose life, that you may live, you and your descendants;
verses.en_bbe: Let heaven and earth be my witnesses against you this day that I have put before you life and death, a blessing and a curse: so take life for yourselves and for your seed:

verses.en: That thou mayest love the LORD thy God, and that thou mayest obey his voice, and that thou mayest cleave unto him: for he is thy life, and the length of thy days: that thou mayest dwell in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.
verses.pt: Que ames ao SENHOR teu Deus, que ouças sua voz, e te achegues a ele; porque ele é tua vida, e o comprimento de teus dias; a fim de que habites sobre a terra que jurou o SENHOR a teus pais Abraão, Isaque, e Jacó, que lhes havia de dar.
verses.en_web: to love Yahweh your God, to obey his voice, and to cling to him; for he is your life, and the length of your days; that you may dwell in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.
verses.en_bbe: In loving the Lord your God, hearing his voice and being true to him: for he is your life and by him will your days be long: so that you may go on living in the land which the Lord gave by an oath to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.
